advertisables.description: Specific advertisables to sync. Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificAdvertisables`.

dimensions.description: The dimenstions that you want to sync.

metrics.description: The metrics that you want to sync.

report_type.description: The report type you want. Default value: `ALL_ADS`.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all advertisables or specific advertisables. Default value: `AllAdvertisables`.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once the connector is created. Default value: `TWELVE`.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your AdRoll client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your AdRoll client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
